known_caveats: Historical CC0 preserved-specimen evidence supports recorded presence only. Metadata recovery accepts an audited stable occurrence ID or archive-bound core ID and may preserve an unknown normalized collection date. Cultivated or captive records, invalid dates, conflicting identities, reviewed source contradictions, non-species ranks, ambiguous taxonomy and unresolved geography are excluded. Raw source details and acquisition bounds remain retained; source silence and every rejected row create no absence or non-detection assertion.
source_warnings: CPNWH physical specimens support historical recorded presence only.
The complete source archive was screened offline; only one strict retained witness per eligible county-species pair is persisted in each immutable run.
Source silence and rejected rows never support absence or non-detection.
